transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well... I guess I'm here because of the messages. The fellas down at the domino table, they... they say things. Little things that are just for me to hear. And sometimes the man on the radio does it too. My wife, she tells me I'm just hearing things, that it's just regular talk. But... I know better. They're trying to warn me. Telling me I need to be careful.
When this happens, do you hear an actual voice speaking when no one is there?

Well... sometimes. Yeah, I suppose so. Some afternoons, when the house gets real quiet... I hear it. Like my old friend calling my name from the porch. Or... or humming a choir song. Sounds clear. Just like he's standing right there. But... that's all.
Have you been told by a doctor that you have any brain or nerve problem?
No... no, nobody ever said nothing about that. Just my regular checkups, mostly.
Have you been feeling unusually high or full of energy for days at a time?

Well... I suppose there are times like that. Weeks where I wake up just... feeling real bright. Important, maybe. I guess I laugh a bit louder, talk faster than usual. But... well, if folks try to slow me down, or ask too many questions... I can get a bit sharp with them. That's all.
Do the messages and voices happen only when you’re in those bright, high-energy periods?

No... not just then. There was a spell... maybe a month or so, where things were quiet. I was sleeping fine, not doing much of anything special. But... I still heard him. And the radio... it still seemed like it was talking to me. Even when I wasn't feeling all... worked up.
Have you ever felt that someone was putting thoughts into your mind or taking thoughts out of it?
No... I don't think so. My thoughts are my own. Just... regular thoughts. Nobody's messing with them.
Have these messages and voices been going on for more than a month?
Well... yes. It's been a while now. I suppose... maybe nine months or so. On and off. They just... come and go. That's all.
Since these experiences began, have you had trouble keeping up with your usual work or daily responsibilities?

Well... yes, I suppose. I haven't been going to choir practice much. And... the garden's gotten a bit away from me. I used to play dominoes with the fellas, but... it just got uncomfortable, so I don't go around for that anymore. Just... haven't been keeping up with things like I used to.
Have you had any seizures?
No. I don't... I haven't had anything like that. Just... no.
Since this started, have you found that your emotions feel flatter or less strong than they used to?

Well... I don't rightly know about flatter. I still love my family, of course. Just... a lot of days, I just sit at the kitchen table. Don't say much of anything. I let the garden and the choir stuff just... go by. Just don't feel like moving much, I suppose.
Do you believe someone is trying to harm you?

Harm? ... I don't rightly know about harm. But... well, I get these little messages. From the fellas at the domino table. And sometimes the radio announcer, too. 

My wife... she says it's just regular talk. But I know better. I know they're warning me. Telling me I need to be careful. That's... well, that's why I came in, I suppose.
Before these messages and voices started, did you begin any new medicines or start using alcohol or drugs more than usual?
No... no new medicines. And I don't drink. Never have been one for drugs or any of that. Just... no.
Have you had a stroke?
No... not that I know of. Never had a stroke.
Have you been seeing things that other people cannot see?

See things? No... no, I don't see nothing like that. 

Just... well, hearing, I suppose. I don't much like talking on it, but... some afternoons, when the house gets real quiet, I hear my old friend. Calling my name from out on the porch. Or humming a choir song. Sounds clear, like he's standing right there. But... I don't see him. Just hear him.
Have you been having trouble with your memory?
My memory? No... not really. I remember things fine, I suppose. Mind still works alright. Just... no trouble with that.
Have there been times when you felt confused or not fully clear-headed?
No... can't say I have. Head's clear enough, mostly. I know where I am and all that. So... no.
Have you had trouble with your hearing?
My hearing? No... ears work alright, I reckon. Catch most of what folks say. So... no trouble there.
Have you ever had spells where you suddenly smell an odor that isn’t really there?
Odors? No... can't say I have. Nose is just... normal, I guess. Ain't smelled nothing that wasn't there. So... no.
Since this started, have you found yourself talking much less than you used to?

I suppose... maybe a bit. I don't say much these days. Mostly just... sit at the kitchen table. I still care for my family, but... just don't feel like talking. Or doing much of anything, really. Let the garden go... stopped going to choir practice. Just... sit there.
Do you ever feel that other people can hear your thoughts, even when you do not say them out loud?
Hear my thoughts? No... no, I don't think so. My thoughts are just... mine. Nobody else's business. So... no, never felt like that.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has persistent psychotic symptoms for about 9 months, including auditory hallucinations and referential/persecutory delusional interpretations ('messages' from domino players and the radio). There is associated social/functional decline and negative-type symptoms such as reduced speech, reduced activity, and avolition. Symptoms are not limited to mood elevation, and no evidence supports a medical/neurological or substance-induced etiology. This pattern is most consistent with schizophrenia, paranoid subtype.
